title: The Shape Wanting Makes
logline: Before seven in the morning, open boats are driven straight up onto a pale beach at the top of the island, and around each catch a ring of people closes, tightens while the price climbs, and opens the second the price is found, forty or fifty times over, until the sand is empty again.
human_question: If you could see wanting from the outside, with nobody's face attached to it, what shape would it turn out to be?

place.what_kind_of_place: A working beach at the northern tip of the island, where a very shallow sea meets a shelf of coral rock and pale sand. There is a small harbour basin at one end, under military oversight, but most of the fleet is small open boats that are run straight up onto the sand and unloaded where they stop. Behind the shore: palmyra, a lighthouse, low houses, a road with ice lorries and bicycles waiting on it, and, running east, a belt of high dunes that goes on for miles. There is no building the trade happens in. The catch is tipped onto wet sand and sold standing up, in the open, in about two hours, and then the beach is a beach again.
place.why_it_is_worth_watching: Three things carry the film with the sound off. The fleet arriving at first light on flat water, a dozen small hulls coming in across a shallow that goes from black to green to white as the sun gets up. The view straight down from height at the middle of it, when a dozen dark rings of people stand on pale sand, each one closed tight around a bright heap, opening and reforming as the next boat lands, a pattern that makes itself and is never the same twice. And the emptying: crates onto bicycles and lorries, ice water running in channels down the slope of the beach, crows on the rock, and then bare wet sand with tyre marks on it and a tide coming quietly over them.
place.what_moves_or_changes: Everything is on the boats' and the sea's schedule and none of it is under the crew's control. Rings form, tighten and open; the calling speeds up and stops; the same fish changes hands more than once before it leaves the beach. The light goes from grey to hard inside an hour. The crowd roughly halves every twenty minutes after eight. Nothing is repeatable and nothing waits, which is why the film has to be built out of the pattern rather than out of any one sale.
place.when_it_looks_best: First light to about nine in the morning, which is the whole working day for this part of the trade. Flat calm and a low sun are what make the overhead work read. The north-east monsoon, roughly October to January, puts heavy weather straight onto this coast and keeps the small boats off it; the calmer stretch from about March to September is when the beach landings are most reliable.

two_layers.without_the_philosophy: A morning on a working beach at the top of the country: boats in, fish out, sold, iced, loaded, gone, and an empty beach by mid-morning. It resolves on its own terms, dark to glare and full to empty, and a viewer who never hears a word of the narration gets a complete piece with arrivals, a peak and a clearance, on a coast almost nobody outside the district has seen.
two_layers.with_the_philosophy: The same footage becomes the group's clearest object. The voice has no person to follow and never looks for one. It names the parts of a wanting moment that the old books list, and every one of them is being performed out loud by a crowd: the mind put onto a thing, the mind kept on it and gone over, the not turning back, the settling on a figure, and the reaching itself, which the books insist is not the same thing as the holding on. The ring is the shape, and it opens every time.

sequence.on_screen: Dark, then the first grey. The drone low over flat water; a line of small open boats coming in with one light each. On the road above the beach an ice lorry waits with its engine off and men sitting on the tailgate.
sequence.voice: Nothing unusual is about to happen here. The old compendium that lists the ordinary occasions of wanting puts earning, keeping and spending among them, alongside a good meal and a new shirt and a day out somewhere. It is not an accusation. It is a description of what most of a working morning is made of.

sequence.on_screen: A boat grounds. The catch goes over the side onto wet sand in one movement: ice, seawater, silver. A buyer crouches, turns a fish over, lifts a gill with a thumb, puts it down, picks up another.
sequence.voice: The books break a moment like this into parts. First the mind is put onto the thing. Then it is kept there and gone over. Their picture for the pair is one hand holding a metal pot steady while the other hand works slowly round it. That is what this is, and it lasts about four seconds.

sequence.on_screen: Straight down from a height. Around the heap on the sand, people close into a ring three deep, shoulders touching. Two more rings are already forming forty metres along the beach.
sequence.voice: There is a separate word in these books for the wish to take a thing up, and both of them go out of their way to say that it is not greed. Greed is the sticking. This is only the reaching. You are looking at the reaching. It has a shape, it is three deep, and it will last about ninety seconds.

sequence.on_screen: Inside the ring. The caller's voice climbing; hands going up and staying up; somebody pushing through to the front; the figures coming faster and closer together.
sequence.voice: Effort, in these books, is the part that does not turn back until the thing is finished, and they are careful that it is not a virtue in itself. Their picture for it is a boat. On a current running the way the mind is already leaning, effort carries it along easily; the other direction is a load taken uphill. There are forty boats on this beach and not one of them tells you which way anybody is going.

sequence.on_screen: The price stops. One hand stays up and the rest come down. The fish go straight into a crate and ice goes over them. From the boat grounding to this, under three minutes.
sequence.voice: Then the mind settles, firmly, on one figure. The books have a word for that too. One of them adds, drily, that it settles just as firmly when it is wrong. The other says it is hard to notice happening at all. Being certain and being right are two different events, and only one of them is visible here.

sequence.on_screen: The plain work of the beach. A knife through a gill; blood thinning in a bucket of seawater; a cut fish on a scale; crows waiting on the rock; a man hosing sand off a crate.
sequence.voice: The trade is what it is and the film does not argue with it. Worth saying, because the book is specific. Of the harmful acts it lists as carried out through wanting there are seven, and the taking of life is not among them. What it is looking at on this beach is the earning, the keeping and the spending, and it says in the same breath that work done with an eye to what is actually useful is not counted against anyone.

sequence.on_screen: The ring opens for the last time and within a minute the same people are closed around another boat further along. Then, by nine, nothing: bicycles going up the road with crates on the back, ice water in channels, bare wet sand, and the tide coming over the tyre marks.
sequence.voice: Every ring on this beach opened. Nothing held. And the books will not let the word be used as an accusation even here, because they say the same reaching, trained and pointed, is what carries a person all the way to the far end of the path. The shape you have been watching all morning is not the problem. Whatever will not let go of it is, and that was never on the sand.

concept_merge.why_together: Read fresh, C005 is not a condemnation of trade and C021 is not a theory of motivation. C005 lists the ordinary occasions on which wanting arises, and earning, guarding and spending wealth are on that list beside tasty food, fine clothes and a trip away [C005-M:L5] [C005-M:L7]; then it draws its line by aim rather than by act and says outright that the same work done from need or practical wisdom is not counted as unwholesome [C005-M:L9]. That is what allows a film to stand in a market at all. It also fixes what this film is not about: of the ten unwholesome courses of action, the seven the source assigns to greed are theft, sexual misconduct, lying, divisive speech, idle chatter, covetousness and view [C005-M:L3], and the taking of life is not among them. C021 supplies the anatomy. The occasional factors are the working parts of any purposeful moment and none of them is good or bad in itself: the mind put onto an object and kept on it, pictured as one hand gripping a vessel while the other works round it [C021-P:L41] [C021-P:L37–L41]; effort, which does not turn back until the task is done and which runs downhill or uphill depending only on the slope it is put on [C021-M:L19] [C021-P:L53]; decision, the mind settling firmly on an object, hard to detect in one source and frequently wrong in the other [C021-M:L15] [C021-P:L45]; and desire-to-act, the wish to take the object up, which both sources separate from greed because it lacks the stickiness [C021-P:L69] [C021-M:L27]. An auction is the one place where a crowd performs that whole anatomy out loud, in public, in under three minutes, with no interior access required and nobody to follow.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: That the reaching and the holding on are two different things, and only the first of them has a shape. C005 on its own would make a film about a trade and would risk becoming an accusation against it. C021 on its own would make a film about concentration and craft. Together they let one shot carry the whole thing: a ring of people closed three deep around a heap of fish on wet sand, seen from directly above, which is the reaching with nobody's face in it, and which opens the moment the price is found. The pairing also shuts the door the earlier draft went through. The interesting fact at an auction is not that somebody loses; it is that the ring dissolves, every time, and the sources' own word for what built it is one they refuse to call greed [C021-P:L75].

concept_links.why: The Margaya's occasions include earning and guarding wealth and the spending of it on what one likes [C005-M:L5] [C005-M:L7], which is the whole of what happens on this beach between five and nine in the morning. The rule attached is why a working trade can be filmed without insult: the same act done from need or with regard to what is useful is explicitly not counted as unwholesome [C005-M:L9], and the digest notes that the source never says what kind of mind those excluded cases are instead, so the film leaves that gap open rather than filling it. Two of the digest's limits do real work here. This is not a case for austerity, since the source allows wealth earned and spent wisely, so a good morning's price must never be allowed to look like a fault. And the source does not dissolve everything into motive: it still names particular actions as courses of harm, and the seven it names as done through wanting are theft, sexual misconduct, lying, divisive speech, idle chatter, covetousness and view [C005-M:L3]. The taking of life is not on that list, which is precisely the film's licence to show the killing, the blood and the dead fish plainly, without flinching from them and without building an argument out of them in either direction.

C021 gives the film its anatomy, and an auction is the only place a crowd performs that anatomy aloud. Initial and sustained application, the mind put onto an object and kept there, arise together and are pictured as one hand gripping a vessel firmly while the other slowly works round it [C021-P:L41] [C021-P:L37–L41], which is a buyer with a fish in his hands. Effort is what will not turn back until the task is done [C021-M:L19], and the sources insist it has no colour of its own, picturing it as a boat carried by a current where the mind already leans and as a load taken uphill where it does not [C021-P:L53]. Decision is the mind settling firmly on an object, called hard to discern by one source and frequently wrong by the other [C021-M:L15] [C021-P:L45], which is what a hammered price is. And desire-to-act, the wish to take the object up, is separated from greed by both sources: it lacks the stickiness, it takes the colour of the mind it joins, and developed it becomes a base of success leading the other way entirely [C021-P:L69] [C021-M:L27] [C021-P:L75]. The digest's warnings are the film's guardrails. This is not follow your passion, because drive inside a greed-rooted mind strengthens the greed. It is not hard work is virtue, because effort is neutral. It is not trust your gut, because the settling is often firm and wrong. And if a buyer's delight is filmed it must not be dressed in the sources' account of rapture moving the body through the air element [C021-P:L61], which the digest says is traditional physiology and does not correspond to the modern kind.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: That wanting, looked at from outside, is a reaching rather than a holding, and that the two can be told apart by watching what happens after the thing is got. The proof needs no belief and no vocabulary: a ring of people three deep around a heap of fish, the price found, and the ring opening and walking away in under a minute, over and over, until there is nothing on the sand.
what_must_be_real: A real landing on a real morning, real boats, real buyers and real prices. No lot is held back, re-called or re-staged; no bid is arranged; nobody is asked to bid again for the camera or to say what they paid. The film follows no individual, does not identify a buyer or a caller, and does not ask anyone why they wanted what they wanted, because the whole claim is that the shape is public and the aim is not. The killing and the handling of dead animals are shown as they happen, neither dwelt on nor edited out. Prices and who bought what stay off the screen unless the people concerned want them on it.
position_hint: closing candidate for the group: the point at which the subject is finally given a visible shape, after earlier films in which it could only be pointed at. No location reasoning is involved.
risks: Letting the film become an exhibit of greed. The sources refuse to settle a working trade from outside [C005-M:L9], and the word is never used of anyone on this beach.
Acquiring a protagonist by accident. The moment the edit starts following one buyer or one caller, the film is about a person again and the whole rewrite is undone.

Building an argument about killing or about eating fish, in either direction. The sources' list of harmful acts done through wanting does not include the taking of life [C005-M:L3], and the film's subject is the ring, not the catch.
The opposite failure: squeamishness. Blood, gutting and dead animals are the ordinary substance of the place and are filmed plainly, without lingering and without a music cue.
Reading effort as virtue or as follow your passion. The digest is explicit that effort is morally neutral and that drive inside a greed-rooted mind strengthens it [C021-P:L53].
Reading the film as desire is the enemy. The sources say the opposite of desire-to-act, which developed leads to the highest good [C021-P:L75], and the last beat exists to refuse that misreading.
Treating a confident decision as a correct one, or letting the edit imply the crew knows which prices were good ones; the sources say the settling is frequently wrong [C021-P:L45].
Dressing a buyer's visible delight in the sources' traditional physiology of rapture [C021-P:L61], which the digest rules out as a modern claim.
Commercial and personal sensitivity around prices, margins and who bought what, in a small trade where everyone knows everyone.
Aestheticising hard, badly paid and dangerous work; the boats, the hours and the state of the trade are shown honestly or not at all.
Access and permission on a coast where part of the working harbour is under military oversight, and drone rules that may simply forbid the film's central shot.
drop_if: The auction can only be filmed by arranging a lot, a bid or a re-call.
Overhead filming cannot be permitted on this coast, so the ring, which is the film's whole statement, cannot be seen as a shape.
Access is offered on condition that the killing, the working conditions or the state of the trade are kept off camera.

connections.note: A price found in the open on a beach in a few minutes, and a duty assessed on a beach two thousand years ago and surviving only as a sentence cut in rock. The transaction visible, and the transaction reduced to its paperwork.

selection.reason: The group's one chance to film wanting as a shape with nobody's face in it, in a place where the whole anatomy the sources describe is performed aloud by a crowd in under three minutes.

review.note: Rewritten into the footage-led shape. Dropped the old situation block and, with it, the buyer who loses the catch to a higher bid: there is no protagonist, nobody in frame is there in order to lose, and the film follows the machine rather than anyone inside it. The auction is now filmed as a pattern, rings of people closing around each catch and opening when the price is found, which is the concept stated rather than illustrated. New title; old title kept in aliases. Both concept links re-tested against their digests and rewritten: C005 is now grounded on its rule that the same work done with regard to what is useful is not counted as unwholesome, and on the fact that the seven greed-rooted courses of action do not include the taking of life, which is what lets the film show the killing plainly; C021 is now grounded on the full anatomy, initial and sustained application, effort, decision and desire-to-act, with the digest's guards against follow-your-passion, hard-work-as-virtue, trust-your-gut and the traditional physiology of rapture. Added place, two_layers, a seven-beat sequence and a proposed location with verified images.

suggested_location.name: Point Pedro beach landings and fishery harbour

also_known_as.name: Paruthithurai
also_known_as.used_by: Tamil usage, the everyday name of the town

suggested_location.region: Vadamarachchi, Jaffna District, Northern Province, at the northernmost point of the island
suggested_location.why_here: It gives the concept and the spectacle in the same frame. The trade here is not conducted inside a hall: the coastline is sandy with coral rock and the boats bring the catch straight onto the beach, so the selling happens in the open, around the catch, on the sand, and the ring of buyers is a shape the drone can see from directly above. That is the film's whole statement in one image, because the ring is wanting with nobody's face in it, and it opens the second the price is found. The fleet is small open boats rather than industrial trawlers, which keeps the scale human and the event repeatable through a morning. The water on this coast is shallow, almost colourless at first light, and the sand is pale, so rings of people read as dark shapes on a plain field, which is exactly what the overhead shot needs. The surroundings are unusual and almost unfilmed: palmyra, a lighthouse, and a belt of high dunes running east for miles. And it is a working town, not a destination; nothing here is arranged for anybody to look at.
what_to_film: The fleet coming in at first light across the shallows, from low over the water and from height, before the sun is hard.
One boat grounding and being unloaded in full, without cutting, so the whole cycle from keel on sand to empty boat is on one piece of film.

The ring from directly overhead: high enough to hold several rings at once, so the pattern of forming and opening reads without any individual being picked out. This is the payoff shot and everything else is built around getting it.
Inside one ring at head height, for the hands, the calling and the moment the hands come down.
A buyer handling fish: turning one over, lifting a gill, putting it down. Close, quiet, nobody talking to camera.
The plain work: gutting, blood in seawater, weighing, icing, crates. Filmed straight, without lingering.
The beach emptying between eight and nine, ending on bare wet sand, channels of ice water, tyre marks and the tide.
The dunes and the palmyra country behind the shore, for the wide establishing work and the sense of where the island stops.
suggested_location.access: By road from Jaffna town, roughly 30 km north-east through Vadamarachchi, with frequent buses; the town is the end of the road at the northernmost point of the island. The beach landings are public ground and access is a matter of the boat owners and the fisheries co-operative society rather than a gate. The harbour basin itself is overseen by the military, so filming there, and flying over it, needs separate permission and should be treated as a distinct request from the beach work. Drone permissions in the north are not assumable.
suggested_location.best_time: First light to about nine in the morning; the trade is finished long before the middle of the day. A flat calm and a low sun are what make the overhead pattern read. The north-east monsoon, roughly October to January, drives heavy weather straight onto this coast and keeps small boats off it, so the calmer stretch from about March to September is the working window. Filming follows the boats' hours rather than setting them.

suggested_location.research_note: Coordinates, district and province, the town's standing as the northernmost point of the island, the small harbour and its military oversight, the sandy and coral-rock coastline with fishermen bringing the daily catch onto the beach, and the belt of high dunes running east along the coast are from the sources above and are desk research only. The description of how a landing is sold, the catch tipped out and the auctioneer calling over it while buyers close in, and the detail that small circles form and bargaining begins around each lot, comes from accounts of peninsula and west-coast landings generally and has not been verified for this particular beach. Boat numbers, landing times, the co-operative society's role, the calmer season, drone rules in the north and whether any crew or buyer will agree to be filmed are all unverified.

unknowns: No crew, buyer, society or permission has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.

Whether the selling at this particular beach takes the ring-around-the-catch form the film is built on, rather than happening at a counter or inside the harbour, is unverified and decides whether the location works at all.
Drone permission over a working shore in the north, next to a harbour under military oversight, has not been assessed and may simply be refused.
How much of the trade has moved into the harbour basin, and therefore out of the open, is unknown.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. The location is Claude's suggestion and awaits Chathura's verdict; its supporting detail is desk research and is unverified. No scene or shot is decided here.
